turck.name: Turck
turck.fullDesc: Turck is a pioneer and world leader in industrial sensor technology, robust field buses (IP67), RFID systems for harsh environments and multi-protocol industrial connectivity.

patlite.name: Patlite
patlite.fullDesc: Patlite is the global reference in optical and acoustic signaling towers for manufacturing process optimization and Andon systems.

meltric.name: Meltric
meltric.fullDesc: Meltric manufactures maximum safety power connectors with patented Decontactor™ technology for quick disconnect under load.

banner.name: Banner Engineering
banner.fullDesc: Banner Engineering is a global leader in photoelectric and ultrasonic sensors, industrial LED illumination, Sure Cross® wireless networks, and machine vision sensors for quality inspection.

woerner.name: Woerner
woerner.fullDesc: Woerner is a German specialist in industrial lubrication engineering with precision centralized grease and oil systems for heavy machinery.

altech.name: Altech Corp
altech.fullDesc: Altech Corp offers components for control panel assembly and industrial automation with international UL, CSA and CE certifications.

delta.name: Delta Electronics
delta.fullDesc: Delta Electronics is a world leader in variable frequency drives, servo systems, high-performance PLCs, HMI screens and industrial power supplies.

datalogic.name: Datalogic
datalogic.fullDesc: Datalogic is a world pioneer in automatic data capture solutions, industrial traceability, machine vision and optoelectronic safety.
